description: Dedicated full-route resolvers for official Google traffic. These routes are intentionally separate from the general AI Smart DNS pool used for ChatGPT and Gemini.

routes.name: EuroDNS NL
routes.notes: Dedicated Google Full route. The resolver maps selected Google hosts to an EU transparent SNI proxy; TLS remains end-to-end. IPv4 A lookups are used intentionally to avoid IPv6/QUIC route leakage.
